proposals.citation: varghese2015palakkad[Appendix B3, item 32, Malasar, Oriental Estate];dedr[entry 1819];dedr[entry 1298]
proposals.evidence: Malasar koḷavikallɨ can be parsed as koḷavi 'grinding pestle' plus kallɨ 'stone': DEDR 1819 gives Tamil/Malayalam kur̤avi 'pestle, rolling grinding stone', and 1298 gives Malayalam kal/kallu 'stone'. The ordered components preserve both visible parts.
